EXT.evidence: Gives a long, detailed story to the whole group right after being introduced ('Oh God... well, it started...'), showing talkativeness in a social setting.

AGR.evidence: Polite and candid about her situation ('Hi, sure!'; openly admits her feelings) and considers others ('kinda hoping that wouldn't be an issue').

CON.evidence: Leaves the wedding at the last minute ('about a half hour before the wedding... had to get out of there'), suggesting poor planning and unreliability.

NEU.evidence: Expresses anxiety and distress: 'Oh God,' 'got really freaked out,' 'just didn't know where to go.'

OPN.evidence: Shows introspection and nonconformity ('Why am I doing this, and who am I doing this for?') and uses imaginative comparisons (gravy boat, Mr. Potato Head).
